E0308

Bare `None` needs a known `T?` type

What

Bare `None` needs a known `T?` type

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Give `None` a known optional type such as `Int?`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0308: tests/ui/binding_none_in_value_arm.stderr.

Error [E0308]: Bare `None` needs a known optional type here
  --> binding_none_in_value_arm.jet:3:18
    |
  3 |         empty :: None
    |                  ^^^^
 Why: `None` only fits where a `T?` is expected (S32)
 Fix: Add a type annotation, or use `None` where the type is already known
